verses.text: Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón, ix yik'kot junjun chaynub' yik incienso heb' winh, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al heb' winh, ix yak'anpaxem incienso heb' winh t'a yib'anh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to manhoklaj ix halani.
Yuj chi' ix elta k'ak' t'a yichanh Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh, ix cham heb' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón: --Haton jun tik syalelk'och slolonel Jehová ix yala': Ha yuj heb' tzin ak'an serwil, ol hin ch'ox hin b'a, to Ha hinxonhej ochi. Ha t'a masanil hin chonhab' ol hin ch'ox hin tzikiki'al, xchi Jehová, xchi winh. Ix em numnaj winhaj Aarón chi', manhxalaj tas ix yal winh.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Moisés chi' ix awtan winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Elzafán, heb' yuninal winhaj Uziel yicham winhaj Aarón chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --Nitzekkot he b'a ha hex tik t'a sti' mantiado b'aj ayek' sniwanil heb' he k'ab' heyok chi', ik'ekel heb' t'a spatikel campamento, xchi winh.

Ix jawi heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' chamnak chi' heb' winh t'a spatikel campamento icha ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi'. Ayto'och spichul heb' chamnak chi' t'ay, haton k'apak sk'antaxon heb' t'a yopisio.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj Aarón yet' t'a chawanhxo heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Manh heyik'el he k'ox ayk'e t'a he jolom, manh he nhik'chitejb'at he pichul yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Haxo talaj tz'aji, tzex champaxi, haxo skot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh ko masanil ha honh israel honh tik. Palta ha masanil heb' ketchonhab' tik syal yok' sk'o'ol heb' yuj mach ix satel Jehová yet' k'ak'.

Manh hex elpax t'a yichanh mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yik wach' manh ol hex chamok, ha hex tik sik'b'il hex eli, ak'b'iloch aceite to yik Jehová t'ayex, xchi winh. Icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Moisés chi', icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb'.
Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winhaj Aarón chi' icha tik:

--Ayik ol hach och ha hach tik, ma heb' uninal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox hin b'a, manh heyuk' wino, ma tastak pajb'inakxo, haxo talaj tz'aji tzex chami. Ha jun tik ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal t'a masanil tiempo.
Manh he k'ulej juntzanh chi' yujto yowalil snachajel heyu'uj, tastak wach' icha yalan ley yet' tastak manh wach'ok.
Yowalil tze k'ayb'ejpax heb' heyetchonhab' t'a juntzanh ley ix hin chek yal winhaj Moisés t'ayex tik, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanpax winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winhaj Aarón yet' pax t'a heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar: --Ik'ekkot ixim harina ixto kan t'a ofrenda ix tz'a t'a yichanh Jehová, tze b'o'an ixim pan malaj yich t'a yichanh altar, yujto ha jun ofrenda chi' yik Jehová yaji.
Tze wa'an t'a junok lugar to yik Jehová yaji, yujto ha ofrenda snhusjitz'a t'a yichanh Jehová ik yaj yet' heb' uninal. Haton juntzanh tik ix alji t'ayin.

Haxo pax nok' snhisk'o'ol sb'akhchajek' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' nok' xub', tz'ik'chajel nok', ha juntzanh chi' heyiktaxon yaji. Tza chi yet' heb' uninal yet' heb' isil t'a junok lugar to wach' yaji icha syal ley, yujto ha juntzanh chi' heyiktaxon yaj t'a silab' sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' ketchonhab' yet' Dios.

Yujto ha nok' xub' tz'ik'ji'el chi' yet' nok' snhisk'o'ol sb'akhji'ek' t'a yichanh Jehová, junnhej tz'aj yak'ji yet' nok' xepu' snhusjitz'a'ok. Ha cha makan nok' chi', ik yet' heb' uninal t'a masanil tiempo icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix sk'anb'anpax winhaj Moisés chi' yuj nok' chiwa ix ak'ji silab'il yuj mul. Haxo ix yalan heb' winh to toxo ix snhustz'a nok' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winh t'a winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Itamar, ix yalan winh icha tik:

--¿Tas yuj maj he chi nok' silab' t'a yamak'il skajnub' Jehová? Ha jun makan silab' chi', yik Jehová yaji, yuj chi' ix ak'ji t'ayex, yuj he chi'an nok', yik tz'ik'ji'el smul heb' molanek' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yujto ha schik'il nok' silab' chi', maj ik'jib'at t'a yol skajnub' Jehová, yuj chi' yowalil to ix he chi nok' t'a yamak'il chi', icha ix aj walan t'ayex, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Aarón icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ix yak' silab' heb' yuj smul yet' silab' to stz'a smasanil, wach'chom icha chi', palta ina wal tas ix jawi t'a wib'anh. Tato ix hin chi nok' silab' ix ak'ji yuj mul chi', ¿tom chab'il hin yuj Jehová tza na'? xchi winhaj Aarón chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Moisés icha chi', ix scha'an sk'o'ol winh.
